name: @box/apis
description: OpenAPI contract and generated clients for BOX3 Local Engine
author: Code Infinity

scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-openapi.mjs && openapi-typescript openapi/openapi.json -o src/generated/openapi.ts && node scripts/generate-client.mjs
scripts.check:openapi: node scripts/generate-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-client.mjs --check && node scripts/check-openapi.mjs
scripts.build: npm run generate && rm -rf dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && rollup --config rollup.config.mjs
